about_note.name: The showcase is one layer per thing mndflow draws. Read the header note, then the tied note on each block: it names the field or setting that makes the block look that way. Overhead and profile on the rail draw the whole tree. Opening a folder draws its folder view. Definitions lists the folders and definitions; structure lists the layers. The workspace roots structure; a definition roots it once it holds blocks of its own. This workspace merges the diagrams package.

c_markdown.name: From a file
c_markdown.body:
# Read from the file

- a heading
- a list

c_note.name: type is note: its text is the card, and its size was set by hand

d_lane_s1.name: Do
d_lane_s1.body: The step in the first lane.

d_lane_s2.name: Done
d_lane_s2.body: The step in the second lane.

d_seq_gone.name: Gone
d_seq_gone.body: A header that refers to nothing.

def_asset.name: Asset
def_asset.body: A thing at a site, in a state.

def_large.name: Large layer
def_large.body: A layer whose cards draw their large face.

def_pump.name: Pump
def_pump.body: Moves liquid from its inlet to its outlet.

diagrams.class_diagram.name: class diagram
diagrams.class_diagram.body: A diagram of the definitions its references stand for, and what they extend.

diagrams.message.name: message
diagrams.message.body: One participant asks another to act: a message between two steps.

diagrams.reply.name: reply
diagrams.reply.body: An answer to a message, drawn dashed.

diagrams.sequence_diagram.name: sequence diagram
diagrams.sequence_diagram.body: A grid read as time: the header row names the participants, and each row is a moment.

diagrams.swimlane.name: swimlane
diagrams.swimlane.body: A grid read as lanes: the header row names the participants, the header column the phases.

f_body.name: Body
f_body.body:
# A heading

Prose with **bold**, `code` and a [link](https://example.com).

- a point
- another point

| part | qty | note |
|---|---|---|
| impeller | 1 | cast |
| seal | 2 | spare |

f_headless.name: Headless
f_headless.body: A card that is its markdown alone: no name over it.

f_sized.name: Sized
f_sized.body: A size its definition gives: 8 by 3 units. What does not fit is cut off, however long the text runs on and on.

l_chain_note.name: A chain of definitions. Open a stand-in for its definition view.

l_class_note.name: Open Classes for the class view.

l_faces_note.name: A layer whose layout.cards is large draws large faces.

l_grids_note.name: A grid seats blocks in cells. The header row and column head the lines, and a merge spans cells. Enter on the grid shows its cells.

l_groups_note.name: A group gathers blocks where they sit, and nests.

l_kinds_note.name: Every block kind on its small face. Open Folder: it holds Inside, and that is not structure.

l_line_defs_note.name: A relation definition says direction, arrows, allowed ends and attributes. Select the line and open its definition from the tray.

l_lines_note.name: Every line setting: direction, a name, arrows, and a tie.

l_markdown_note.name: A card can be a markdown file: regenerating reads it again.

l_model_note.name: Attributes typed by a definition draw links between stand-ins.

l_ports_note.name: Ports placed, and ports that place themselves.

l_refs_note.name: A reference stands for something drawn elsewhere.

l_routing_note.name: What the router must get right: a detour, one line both ways, a crossing, a close pair, and a hub that fans out.

l_sequence_note.name: Open Messages: lifelines, a self message, and a lifeline whose header refers to nothing.

l_styles_note.name: Settings change a card's look, on a definition or on a single block.

l_swimlane_note.name: Open Lanes: columns are lanes, rows are phases.

l_two_views_note.name: One grid drawn two ways: the grid as a sequence, and a reference to it with layout.view swimlane as lanes.

l_values_note.name: Usages answer attributes. A value naming another card draws a link.

n_c_block.name: type is block, the default kind.

n_c_folder.name: type is folder: it holds Inside, and holds no structure.

n_c_markdown.name: source is the markdown file: name, tags and one attribute come from its frontmatter.

n_c_ref.name: type is reference, of Block: it stands in, and wears Ref.

n_d_b1.name: A usage answering Big pump, down the whole chain.

n_d_class.name: layout.view is class: Part extends Unit, and a link is named unit.

n_d_lanes.name: layout.view is swimlane. The steps say what they do in body.

n_d_p1.name: A usage answering Pump, including what it inherits.

n_d_seq.name: layout.view is sequence. The self message is typed message.

n_f_body.name: card.face is document, and the body is markdown.

n_f_headless.name: card.name is hide: the name is not drawn.

n_f_media.name: card.face is picture, and source is the file it draws.

n_f_plain.name: No card.face: the name is the whole card.

n_f_sized.name: card.size is 8 by 3: overflow is cut.

n_f_spec.name: card.face is table: attributes, then the body.

n_h_grid.name: type is Table, which has has_head. Enter shows the cells.

n_h_outer.name: type is group: it gathers the blocks where they sit.

n_ld_machine.name: A machine, one end drives allows.

n_ld_pump.name: drives runs here from the compressor, ratio 3, pointing forward.

n_m_asset.name: Asset's site attribute is typed Site, so a link draws.

n_m_state.name: State extends choice: running or stopped.

n_p_drain.name: The room's own port, placing itself.

n_p_gauge.name: Its line meets the room's wall.

n_p_pump.name: Its ports are placed, each with a flow: in, out, both, or none.

n_p_valve.name: Its port places itself, and a line holds it.

n_r_arrows_b.name: line.from_arrow is diamond and line.to_arrow is open.

n_r_det_b.name: The line must go round the blocker.

n_r_gap_b.name: The pair sits close, and the line still clears them.

n_r_hub.name: The hub's lines share a trunk and fan out.

n_r_named_b.name: The line's own name is feeds.

n_r_par_b.name: One line, both ways: request and reply share it.

n_r_tie_to.name: type is tie: it runs straight, and is not routed.

n_ref_cards.name: Block kinds, faces, styles and a markdown card.

n_ref_data.name: Attributes typed by a definition, and the usages that answer them.

n_ref_defs.name: A definition chain, and a relation definition.

n_ref_diagrams.name: Class, swimlane and sequence, and one grid drawn two ways.

n_ref_hold.name: A group that nests, and a grid with headers.

n_ref_ports.name: Ports placed, and ports that place themselves.

n_ref_refs.name: A reference to a block, a definition, or nothing.

n_ref_rels.name: Line direction, arrows, ties and routing.

n_ref_two.name: This reference states its own layout.view: swimlane.

n_s_def_bigpump.name: Big pump adds stages, and a thick border.

n_s_def_machine.name: Machine adds power, and a port.

n_s_def_pump.name: Pump adds flow, ports, the rotating tag and a hue.

n_st_away.name: style.family is away, a second value of the same setting.

n_u_p1.name: site names North, and state is running.

n_u_p2.name: site names North, and state is stopped.

n_x_block.name: of is a block on Kinds.

n_x_gone.name: of names nothing: the card is missing.

r_tie_note.name: A tie joins a note to what it is about

rel_drives.name: drives
rel_drives.body: A machine turning a pump's shaft.
